sloka: न मे तथा पार्थिव धीयते मनो ।महत्सु कामेषु न च आत्मनः प्रिये ।यथा निदेशे तव शिष्ट सम्मते ।व्यपैतु दुह्खम् तव मत् कृते अनघ ॥२-३४-५७॥
transliteration: na me tathā pārthiva dhīyate mano ।mahatsu kāmeṣu na ca ātmanaḥ priye ।yathā nideśe tava śiṣṭa sammate ।vyapaitu duhkham tava mat kṛte anagha ॥2-34-57॥

translations.english: O king my mind derives no happiness from great enjoyment or personal comfort as it does from carrying out your order. This is corroborated by the wise. Your grief (relating to filfilment of the vow) on mt account will be dispelled, O sinless one
